rules.requirement: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

assertingTests.name: Saint loses on execution and Mayor wins at three alive without execution (TB-MAYOR-01, TB-SAINT-01)
a corpse execution counts as an execution event and prevents the Mayor win (TB-MAYOR-01)
a Mayor redirect onto the Imp is not the Imp's self-kill (TB-MAYOR-01)
an Imp attack on a working Mayor waits for the host's redirect and changes nothing (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
a redirected Imp attack kills the host's choice and journals the redirect before the attack line (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
the host may let the Mayor die: the answer is journaled and the death is not a redirect (TB-MAYOR-01)
an Imp attack on a working Mayor is a host choice on the command path and the answer completes it (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
